name: get_weather
description: Retrieves the current weather for a specified location, including temperature, conditions, and an evaluation of whether it is suitable for an outdoor study break. Sahayak uses this to recommend whether a student should take their study break outside.

location.description: The city or locality name, e.g., 'Bangalore', 'Mumbai', 'London'

name: calculate_study_schedule
description: Calculates a structured day-by-day study schedule given an exam date, available daily study hours, and a list of topics to cover. Computes remaining days and distributes topics evenly.

exam_date.description: The date of the exam in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-09-15')

hours_per_day.description: Daily study hours available (must be greater than 0)

topics.description: List of topics or chapters to cover before the exam

name: search_topic_summary
description: Searches for an academic or subject topic on Wikipedia to get an authoritative brief summary and reference URL. Used for grounding factual explanations.

topic.description: The concept, topic, or subject name to search (e.g., 'Newton's laws of motion', 'Photosynthesis')
